head: LinkedIn profile views may show how often someone looked at you
dek: LinkedIn is testing a frequent viewer label in Premium's Who viewed your profile list, showing whether a person came back to your profile and how many times, Wired reported. LinkedIn confirmed the test but shared no other details.
details: Premium subscribers can already see who viewed their profile. The test adds a visit count or frequency marker next to each viewer for a given period. There's no word on when or whether it reaches everyone.
means: If you check someone's profile often, a Premium member may soon see that you came back more than once.
